repository_path_note: BoxFusion is the historical repository path, not the project name.
core_claim: RSLG-SLAM is a rich-semantic, light-geometry indoor world-modeling system.

scene_input_contract.dataset_setting: Scene-specific inputs are RGB images, depth images, and provided camera poses.

allowed_internal_derived_artifacts: RSLG-SLAM pipeline products derived from RGB-D plus pose
forbidden_world_model_sources: simulator navmesh used as a world-model source
real_world_deployment_wording: SLAM/localization front-end + RSLG-SLAM semantic-topological world-modeling backend + downstream routing/execution interface
navigation_resource_policy: Navigation resources may be generated by downstream builders, but they must be RSLG-SLAM pipeline products derived from RGB-D plus pose through the World Model Layer and formal artifact builders.
